subject: Request: raw token ledger + how commit tiers / discounts applied
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@fintegrate.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finance Team <procurement@fintegrate.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Raw export: need per-token & discount mapping for Nov reconciliation

Hi Naomi,

We're closing November books and our accounting team needs a detailed export that maps every billed token to the following fields: timestamp, request_id, endpoint (text_generation/chat/embeddings), model_name, token_type (prompt/completion), token_count, cost_per_token, applied_unit_price_after_discount, invoice_id, billing_period_month, region/route (hosted/dedicated), and any credit offsets (reserved commit usage).

Specific asks:
- CSV with header and one row per request (not aggregated per invoice).
- Clear column that shows which committed tier (if any) the token was charged against and the per-token discount applied.
- Flag for prorated commits (if the commit started mid-month).

Also: for our contract (RW-2026-FN-3421) we need a short note describing how overage is billed (monthly overage vs true-up at year-end) and whether discounts are applied before or after taxes/credits. Can you get this to us by EOD Friday?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reyes
Director, Finance
Fintegrate

--

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear breakdown. Looping in Rishi (Sales Ops / Billing) and Jordan (Product) so we can provide a CSV sample and the exact billing rules. Quick note on timeline: Rishi can produce the sample export and the column definitions; Jordan will confirm the pricing application logic and proration rules. I can confirm the contractual bits (overage vs true-up) once Sales Ops verifies how the RW-2026-FN-3421 commit was provisioned (monthly vs annual true-up).

We should be able to get a draft CSV and the billing note by Friday EOD; if we hit any scoping issues (e.g., request-level IDs missing in our historical logs) I’ll surface that early.

Best,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Raw export: need per-token & discount mapping for Nov reconciliation

Hi Tom / Naomi — attaching a sample CSV layout and a short export spec. Deliverables I can provide this week:

1) token_export_sample_202611.csv (attached) — columns: timestamp, request_id, endpoint, model_name, token_type, token_count, base_unit_price, discount_applied_pct, unit_price_after_discount, billed_amount, invoice_id, billing_period, commit_bucket_id, commit_monthly_allocated_tokens, prorated_flag, credit_applied_id

2) Commit_Tier_Schedule_2026Q4.pdf — the tier schedule we applied for RW-2026-FN-3421 (shows thresholds and effective unit prices).

Notes on billing rules:
- Discounts are applied at the unit price level (base_unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)) before tax. Credits from unused commits are applied as invoice-level offsets after per-token billing but are visible as a separate column (credit_applied_id) in the export.
- For mid-month commit activations we prorate the monthly allocated tokens pro-rata to the active days and mark prorated_flag = TRUE. Excess usage first consumes remaining monthly commit allocation, then overage is billed at the next tier's overage price.
- Overage handling: for this deal we configured monthly overage billing (customer pays overage on the monthly invoice) and a year-end true-up is optional only when explicitly negotiated; RW-2026-FN-3421 does not include automatic year-end true-up.

Open items for you, Tom:
- Confirm whether you want the export as "one row per request" for the last 90 days or a full calendar-month extraction per invoice. Full request-level exports are large; we can provide a month-by-month compressed CSV or a rolling 90-day detailed view.
- Confirm if you need the request body hashed (we can include a request_hash column) for correlating with your logs.

I’ll push the full Nov month extract tomorrow and can drop a drive link here.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sales Operations — Billing
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: token_export_sample_202611.csv, Commit_Tier_Schedule_2026Q4.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@fintegrate.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 17:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Raw export: need per-token & discount mapping for Nov reconciliation

Hi all — quick product clarification to avoid reconciliation surprises:

- Model variants: when a request is routed to a compatible lower-cost variant due to capacity fallbacks, we record the actual model_name executed and the applied unit_price in the export. Your invoice will reflect executed model pricing, not the original requested model.

- Aggregation windows: token counting is done at request scope; however, some internal batching (continuous batching) can impact how prompt/completion tokens are labeled in edge cases. The export flags these edge cases with a "batching_flag" column and notes the contiguous request_ids consumed.

- Commitment buckets: commit_bucket_id maps to the purchase order line we reserved. If you need PO numbers instead, tell Rishi and we’ll map bucket -> PO.

Rishi — for completeness, can you also attach the signed SLA clause we referenced (customer asked about overage vs true-up) so procurement has the contractual language? Naomi — happy to review the short billing blurb before you send it to Fintegrate.

-Jordan
Product Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: signed_SLA_2026.docx (attached by Rishi)

Tom — following up with everything attached and next steps:

- I've uploaded the full Nov month export (request-level) to the Drive folder we share: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-fintegrate-billing (file: fintegrate_nov2026_token_export.csv.gz).
- Attached to this thread are the token_export_sample_202611.csv (schema), Commit_Tier_Schedule_2026Q4.pdf (tier schedule), and signed_SLA_2026.docx (contract excerpt about billing).
- Quick summary: your deal RW-2026-FN-3421 is monthly-committed. Discounts apply at the per-token unit price prior to taxes. Overages are invoiced monthly; no automatic year-end true-up is included. Prorated months are flagged in the export.

Next steps for you: Please confirm whether your AP team needs PO numbers in the CSV (we can add a po_number column mapped from commit_bucket_id) and whether you want us to produce a condensed "invoice reconciliation" CSV that aggregates to invoice line items for your AP ledger.

If everything looks good, I’ll have Rishi send a formal invoice adjustment note and a one-page reconciliation summary for your accounting team by Wednesday.

Best,
Naomi
